description_optimization.optimized_description:
This workflow template demonstrates the use of the Question and Answer (Q&A) tool to optimize costs in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) use cases. It is designed for users who wish to empower their agents with knowledge derived from custom documents.

Trigger: The workflow is initiated when the user executes the workflow and uploads a PDF document containing the custom knowledge intended for the agent.

Data Sources and APIs Needed:
1. A PDF document that contains the custom knowledge.
2. Optional: Access to Google Drive for additional knowledge files.
3. Optional: A database or table for loading knowledge.

Operations and Processing Steps:
1. User executes the workflow and uploads the PDF document.
2. The workflow processes the uploaded PDF to extract relevant information.
3. The extracted knowledge is stored in a vector store for easy retrieval.
4. The Q&A tool is configured to utilize the knowledge from the vector store.
5. Users can customize the agent's behavior by modifying the prompts used in the Q&A tool.
6. Users have the option to load knowledge from alternative sources, such as Google Drive files or a database table, by integrating additional nodes into the workflow.
7. Users can enhance the description of their data within the Q&A tool to ensure clarity and relevance.
8. Users can replace the default "Simple Vector Store" nodes with their own production-ready vector store solutions.
9. Users can implement advanced ranking algorithms to improve the relevance of files retrieved from the vector store.

Final Output or Action: The workflow enables users to interact with their agents through a chat interface, utilizing the knowledge extracted from the uploaded PDF and any additional sources configured in the workflow. The agent responds to user queries based on the information stored in the vector store, providing accurate and contextually relevant answers.

For further details and guidance, users are encouraged to refer to the documentation on RAG in n8n available at the provided link. This workflow serves as a foundational template that can be customized to meet specific needs and enhance the capabilities of agents in RAG scenarios.
description_optimization.original_description:
This template shows how to use the Question and Answer tool to save costs in RAG use cases.

## Who is this for?
This template is for everyone who wants to start giving knowledge to their Agents through RAG.

## Requirements
Have a PDF with custom knowledge that you want to provide to your agent.

## Setup
No setup required. Just hit `Execute Workflow`, upload your knowledge document and then start chatting.

## How to customize this to your needs
1. Add custom instructions to your Agent by changing the prompts in it.
2. Add a different way to load in knowledge to your vector store, e.g. by looking at some Google Drive files or loading knowledge from a table.
3. Describe your data properly in the Q&A tool
4. Exchange the `Simple Vector Store` nodes with your own vector store tools ready for production.
5. Add a more sophisticated way to rank files found in the vector store.

For more information read our [docs on RAG in n8n](https://docs.n8n.io/advanced-ai/rag-in-n8n/).
